outcomes: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 made instant triple talaq a crime.
events.yearHook: Verdict 2017 → law 2019.

events.title: 102nd Amendment — constitutional status to NCBC
events.summary: National Commission for Backward Classes gets constitutional status (Art. 338B).
events.detail:
Parallel to NCSC/NCST commissions.

**Exam hooks:** 102nd (2018) → NCBC; 105th (2021) restored states' power to make OBC lists.
outcomes: NCBC became a constitutional body under Article 338B.
events.yearHook: NCBC statutory 1993 → constitutional 2018.

events.title: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) launched
events.summary: World's largest health-assurance scheme — ₹5 lakh cover per family.
events.detail:
Plus Health & Wellness Centres.

**Exam hooks:** PM-JAY (2018); ~50 crore beneficiaries.

events.title: Navtej Johar — decriminalising Section 377
events.summary: SC reads down Section 377; consensual same-sex relations decriminalised.
events.detail:
Affirmed dignity and equality under Articles 14, 15, 21.

**Exam hooks:** Navtej Singh Johar (2018).
outcomes: Consensual same-sex relations between adults decriminalised (6 September 2018).
events.yearHook: 6 September 2018.

events.title: 103rd Amendment — 10% EWS reservation
events.summary: Introduces reservation for Economically Weaker Sections; upheld in 2022.
events.detail:
First reservation on purely economic criteria.

**Exam hooks:** 103rd (2019) upheld by SC in Janhit Abhiyan (2022).
outcomes: Up to 10% reservation for economically weaker sections (Articles 15(6), 16(6)); upheld in 2022 (Janhit Abhiyan).

events.title: Abrogation of Article 370
events.summary: J&K special status revoked; state reorganised into two UTs.
events.detail:
Upheld by the SC in December 2023.

**Exam hooks:** Art. 370 (temporary); J&K & Ladakh became UTs.
outcomes: J&K Reorganisation Act 2019: UTs of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh (31 October 2019) (NCERT).
Upheld by the Supreme Court (December 2023).
events.yearHook: 5 August 2019 (NCERT).

events.title: PM-KISAN income support launched
events.summary: ₹6,000/year direct income support to farmer families.
events.detail:
Direct Benefit Transfer in three instalments.

**Exam hooks:** PM-KISAN (2019); DBT to farmers.

events.title: Three-capital proposal
events.summary: AP proposes Visakhapatnam (executive), Amaravati (legislative), Kurnool (judicial).
events.detail:
Contested in courts; later reversed, restoring Amaravati as sole capital.

**Exam hooks:** three-capital debate (2020) → Amaravati-only restoration (2024–26).
outcomes: The Act was repealed in November 2021; the High Court ruled for Amaravati (March 2022).
events.yearHook: 2020 Act → repealed 2021.
events.before: The new government (2019) said a single capital would concentrate growth; Amaravati farmers protested for years.
events.after: The 2020 Act was repealed (November 2021); the High Court ruled for Amaravati (March 2022). Amaravati was later made the permanent sole capital by law (2026).
events.today: The three-capital idea echoed the old **Sri Bagh** worry of Rayalaseema (Kurnool as judicial capital).

events.title: COVID-19 pandemic
events.summary: WHO declares a pandemic; global lockdowns; India's vaccine drive.
events.detail:
Accelerated digital adoption & telemedicine.

**Exam hooks:** COVID-19 (2020); Covaxin (Bharat Biotech) & Covishield.

events.title: National Education Policy 2020
events.summary: Replaces the 1986 policy; 5+3+3+4 structure; mother-tongue instruction.
events.detail:
Targets 6% of GDP on education.

**Exam hooks:** NEP 2020; Kasturirangan committee.

events.title: AP reorganised into 26 districts
events.summary: District count raised from 13 to 26 for better administration.
events.detail:
New districts aligned largely with Lok Sabha constituencies.

**Exam hooks:** 13 → 26 districts (4 April 2022); later 28 (end-2025).
outcomes: 13 districts became 26 (4 April 2022).
events.before: AP had 13 districts since 1970 (Prakasam was the last new one) and one of India's largest average district sizes.
events.after: New districts were named after people and places: Alluri Sitharama Raju, Parvathipuram Manyam, Anakapalli, Kakinada, Konaseema (Dr B. R. Ambedkar Konaseema), Eluru, NTR, Bapatla, Palnadu, Nandyal, Sri Sathya Sai, Annamayya, Tirupati. Two more came at the end of 2025 (28).
events.today: Most new districts match a Lok Sabha constituency (with changes for the Araku seat, which is split).

events.title: INS Vikrant — first indigenous aircraft carrier
events.summary: India commissions its first home-built aircraft carrier.
events.detail:
Boosted self-reliance in defence (Atmanirbhar Bharat).

**Exam hooks:** INS Vikrant (IAC-1); built at Cochin Shipyard.

events.title: 106th Amendment — Women's Reservation
events.summary: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam — 33% seats for women in Lok Sabha & Assemblies.
events.detail:
Implementation tied to delimitation & census.

**Exam hooks:** 106th Amendment (2023) = one-third women's reservation.
outcomes: One-third of seats in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies reserved for women, after the next census and delimitation.
events.yearHook: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023.

events.title: Aditya-L1 solar mission launched
events.summary: India's first dedicated solar observatory at the L1 point.
events.detail:
Studies the solar corona & solar wind.

**Exam hooks:** Aditya-L1 (2023) at Sun-Earth Lagrange-1.

events.title: Chandrayaan-3 lands near the lunar south pole
events.summary: India becomes the first country to soft-land near the Moon's south pole.
events.detail:
Vikram lander & Pragyan rover; 23 Aug = National Space Day.

**Exam hooks:** Chandrayaan-3 (2023); Aditya-L1 solar mission followed.

events.title: India hosts the G20 Summit (New Delhi)
events.summary: India's G20 presidency; African Union admitted as a member.
events.detail:
Theme "Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam"; Delhi Declaration.

**Exam hooks:** G20 New Delhi (2023); AU joins the G20.

events.title: SSLV maiden success
events.summary: Small Satellite Launch Vehicle for on-demand small-payload launches.
events.detail:
Targets the commercial small-satellite market.

**Exam hooks:** SSLV complements PSLV/GSLV/LVM3.

events.title: Swarna Andhra Vision @2047
events.summary: AP's long-term development vision aligned with India@2047.
events.detail:
Targets growth, e-governance and regional balance.

**Exam hooks:** Swarna Andhra @2047 — state vision document.

events.title: Visakhapatnam as AP's financial/IT hub
events.summary: Vizag emerges as residuary AP's largest commercial & IT centre.
events.detail:
De facto financial capital after the loss of Hyderabad.

**Exam hooks:** Visakhapatnam — largest city & commercial hub of AP.

events.title: AP reorganised into 28 districts
events.summary: District count rises to 28 (Polavaram & Markapuram carved out), w.e.f. 31 Dec 2025.
events.detail:
Latest administrative reorganisation of residuary Andhra Pradesh.

**Exam hooks:** 28 districts w.e.f. 31 Dec 2025; Madanapalle is HQ of Annamayya (not a new district).

participants.role: Annamayya district is named after him.

events.before: The 2022 reorganisation had made 26 districts.
events.after: The current count is 28 districts (w.e.f. 31 December 2025).
events.today: For exams, learn the new district HQs; Madanapalle is the HQ of Annamayya (not a new district).

events.title: AP anti-narcotics & governance drives (2025-26)
events.summary: State e-governance, welfare and anti-drug initiatives feature in current affairs.
events.detail:
Part of AP's 2025-26 governance agenda.

**Exam hooks:** track AP-specific schemes for the regional CA section.

events.title: 53rd Chief Justice of India sworn in
events.summary: A new Chief Justice of India assumes office (24 Nov 2025).
events.detail:
Head of the judiciary; appointments via the collegium.

**Exam hooks:** CJI = head of the Supreme Court; Art. 124 appointment.

events.title: India in the Global Innovation Index 2025
events.summary: India's ranking in the WIPO Global Innovation Index.
events.detail:
Tracks innovation inputs & outputs.

**Exam hooks:** GII by WIPO; India among the top-40 & leading lower-middle-income economies.

events.title: 2025 Nobel Peace Prize
events.summary: Awarded to María Corina Machado (Venezuela) for democracy advocacy.
events.detail:
Recognises the struggle for democratic rights.

**Exam hooks:** Nobel Peace Prize awarded at Oslo (others at Stockholm).

events.title: Noida International Airport inaugurated
events.summary: Major greenfield airport at Jewar (Noida) opens.
events.detail:
Among India's largest planned airports.

**Exam hooks:** Noida Intl Airport (Jewar), UP.

events.title: Amaravati made permanent sole capital (statutory)
events.summary: AP Reorganization (Amendment) Act, 2026 gives Amaravati permanent sole-capital status.
events.detail:
Amends Section 5(2) of the 2014 Act; President's assent early April 2026.

**Exam hooks:** Amaravati permanent capital law (2026); ends the three-capital uncertainty.
events.before: After the three-capital years (2019–24) the new government (2024) restarted Amaravati.
events.after: The amendment to Section 5(2) of the 2014 Act gives Amaravati statutory status as the sole capital.
events.today: Amaravati's legal status is now settled by a central law.

events.title: Indian Railways' first humanoid robot "ASC ARJUN"
events.summary: "Rail Robocop" deployed at an AP station on 22 Jan 2026.
events.detail:
A security/surveillance humanoid on the railway network.

**Exam hooks:** ASC ARJUN — first Indian Railways humanoid robot.

events.title: AP Budget 2026–27 presented
events.summary: State budget with capital outlay for Amaravati & Polavaram; Swarna Andhra Vision@2047.
events.detail:
Amaravati capital-city dev ~₹6,000 cr; Polavaram ~₹6,105 cr.

**Exam hooks:** AP Budget 2026-27; Swarna Andhra @2047 vision.

events.title: Amaravati Quantum Valley Tech Park
events.summary: Public-private tech park aiming to build India's largest quantum computer.
events.detail:
Partners include leading global tech & quantum firms.
